Its smaller footprint is one of its strengths, especially for drivers who want something easy to handle in town.

With 84,014 miles, this 2018 Mitsubishi Mirage G4 ES shows normal use for the year and category. Day-one inventory status gives it fresh-market exposure, which matters. For buyers shopping on value, efficiency, and basic transportation, a clean compact sedan like this can still carve out a solid place in the market.
